EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for contacting ASU College of Nursing and Health Innovation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the College of Nursing & Health Innovation at Arizona State University.
Our RN to BSN program provides associate degree and diploma trained nurses an opportunity to complete upper-division degree requirements leading to a BSN. The program is delivered entirely online which allows nurses to continue working in their profession while completing their bachelor’s degree. With five start dates per year and classes running every 7.5 weeks, students can expect to complete their BSN in as little as 15 to 18 months.
The curriculum for this program, including all lower division pre- and co-requisites and upper division core courses, can be viewed online.
You may also find the following resources useful when considering and applying to ASU: RN to BSN Program Description Nursing Scholarships ASU Scholarship Search
To begin the RN to BSN program, you will first need to apply to ASU.
If you have any questions, please contact ASU Online at 1-855-348-2439.
Sincerely,
Recruitment and Admissions College of Nursing and Health Innovation Phone: 602-496-0937 Office Hours: Monday - Friday, 8 a.m. - 5 p.m. asu.bsn@asu.edu nursingandhealth.asu.edu
